title: Localization-Quality Evaluation for Spatial Attribution (Section 4.4 reference implementation)
description: Single-file C++17 reference implementation of Section 4.4 (localization-quality evaluation) of a dissertation on hybrid Bayesian tactical spatial identification of Wi-Fi signal sources. Computes the full metric panel: central error (MAE, median, RMSE, MAD, trimmed mean), empirical CDF/CCDF and P50/P75/P90/P95/P99, zonal correctness, availability and time-to-localize, HPD coverage at 50/80/90/95% with area and sharpness-conditional-on-coverage, zonal Brier score and NLL, block-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (resampling session/site blocks, not frames), and trajectory-aware aggregation. The demonstration contrasts a well-calibrated arm with an over-confident one to show that point accuracy is separated from posterior honesty. No external dependencies; runs as-is on OnlineGDB. Synthetic illustration, not empirical results; operating points are to_be_validated.
